-- Assumptions: orders(total_amount, currency, status, created_at)
-- "paid or shipped" = status in ('paid','shipped'); period filtered on created_at in UTC.
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount::numeric), 0), 2) AS revenue_eur
FROM orders
WHERE currency = 'EUR'
  AND LOWER(status) IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND created_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+00';

SELECT to_char(COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0), 'FM999999999990.00')
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND o.currency = 'EUR'
  AND o.created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND o.created_at <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+00';

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_eur
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <  TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00';

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_eur

```sql
DO $$
DECLARE
  cnt   int;
  tbl   regclass;
  col   name;
  cname name;
BEGIN
  -- Foreign keys whose referencing table has no index leading with the FK column
  WITH missing AS (
    SELECT c.conname, c.conrelid, c.conkey[1] AS attnum
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_class t     ON t.oid = c.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
    WHERE c.contype = 'f'
      AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i
        WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid
          AND i.indkey[0] = c.conkey[1]
      )
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO cnt FROM missing;

  IF cnt <> 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'expected exactly 1 unindexed foreign key, found %; no changes made', cnt;
  END IF;

  WITH missing AS (
    SELECT c.conname, c.conrelid, c.conkey[1] AS attnum
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_class t     ON t.oid = c.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
    WHERE c.contype = 'f'
      AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i
        WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid
          AND i.indkey[0] = c.conkey[1]
      )
  )
  SELECT m.conrelid::regclass, a.attname, m.conname
    INTO tbl, col, cname
  FROM missing m
  JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = m.conrelid AND a.attnum = m.attnum;

  EXECUTE format('CREATE INDEX %I ON %s (%I)', left('idx_' || cname, 63), tbl, col);
END $$;
```

This uses a plain `CREATE INDEX`, not `CONCURRENTLY`, because a `DO` block runs inside a transaction. That takes a write lock on the table while the index builds.

```sql
DO $$
DECLARE
  r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT c.oid AS constraint_oid,
           c.conrelid,
           n.nspname,
           t.relname,
           c.conname,
           (SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY k.ord)
              FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord)
              JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) AS cols
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
    WHERE c.contype = 'f'
      AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
      AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pg_index i
        WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid
          AND i.indpred IS NULL
          AND (string_to_array(i.indkey::text, ' ')::int2[])[1:cardinality(c.conkey)] @> c.conkey
          AND (string_to_array(i.indkey::text, ' ')::int2[])[1:cardinality(c.conkey)] <@ c.conkey
      )
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS %I ON %I.%I (%s)',
                   left('idx_' || r.relname || '_' || r.conname, 63),
                   r.nspname, r.relname, r.cols);
  END LOOP;
END
$$;
```
